LEFT

FROM `obj_new` `o`

  `o`.`workspace_id` = ?
AND ( `o`.`obj_type_id` in ( ... )

AND `o`.`obj_type_id` in ( ... ) )
AND EXISTS (
SELECT ?

AND ( `subo1`.`text_value_8` = ?
AND `subo1`.`obj_type_id` in ( ... ) ) ) )
ORDER BY `o`.`label` asc
LIMIT ?
OFFSET ?

Normalized SQL 
SELECT
  `o`.`sequential_id`,
  `o`.`label`
FROM `obj_new` `o`
WHERE
  `o`.`workspace_id` = ?
AND ( `o`.`obj_type_id` in ( ... )
AND EXISTS (
SELECT ?
FROM `obj_relationship_new` `subr`
INNER
JOIN `obj_new` `subo1`
ON `subr`.`referenced_object_id` = `subo1`.`id`
AND `subo1`.`obj_type_id` in ( ... )
WHERE
  `o`.`id` = `subr`.`object_id`
AND `subo1`.`workspace_id` = ?
AND EXISTS (
SELECT ?
FROM `obj_relationship_new` `subr1`
INNER
JOIN `obj_new` `subo2`
ON `subr1`.`referenced_object_id` = `subo2`.`id`
AND `subo2`.`obj_type_id` in ( ... )
WHERE
  `subo1`.`id` = `subr1`.`object_id`
AND `subo2`.`workspace_id` = ?
AND EXISTS (
SELECT ?
FROM `obj_relationship_new` `subr2`
INNER
JOIN `obj_new` `subo3`
